description: A boat at anchor, for the Hoeken plugin (the default anchor.plugin). Engines are off (the anchor profile: Hoeken drops its watch if it sees an engine turning). At 0 s the anchoralarm plugin's anchor is cleared so only Hoeken watches. At 2 s the anchor is dropped where the boat is (45 m limit, as the DROP button does), then the boat swings 28-30 m out. From 40 s it drifts to about 52 m, past the limit, and the plugin raises the anchor alarm (the plugin does it, from the position; nothing is written to notifications). From 70 s it is back inside and the plugin clears it. The anchor is raised at 85 s. Needs hoekens-anchor-alarm enabled. anchor-holding-anchoralarm does the same for the anchoralarm plugin.

after.note: only one plugin watches: clear the other's anchor (best effort)
clear any Hoeken anchor left from before (best effort)
drop the anchor here, 45 m limit
drifts to about 52 m, past the 45 m limit: the plugin raises the alarm
back inside the limit: the plugin clears the alarm
